records.text: Five days after Charlie Kirk's assassination, Erika Kirk held a Zoom call recommending that employees take time off to grieve; Owens said that, apparently, Erika Kirk and Stacy Sheridan were in the office every day afterward.

appearances.snippet: We also now are in possession of a Zoom call, which Erika (Erika Kirk) held as the new CEO just five days after Charlie (Charlie Kirk) was publicly assassinated. And one of the strangest things is that she recommends that if employees need. uh time to grieve that they take time off what's strange about that is the employees are like maybe you need to take time off because your husband just got publicly they thought it was very strange and apparently she didn't now everyone's saying she was in the office every day with Stacey Sheridan I told you that's like the chief fundraiser lady they're in the office every day following Charlie (Charlie Kirk)'s assassination They got to that $250 million, so I guess it was worth it, but the people thought it was a bit off-putting, and we have that call, and I can confirm that's not hearsay. verification.notes: The episode presents a purported staff Zoom recording in which Erika Kirk recommends employees take time to grieve, and Owens separately reports that Kirk and Stacy Sheridan were in the office daily.
